# skills.tryopenclaw.io — Platform Skills index

AI-friendly playbooks for OpenClaw Platform Skills. Fetched at runtime by the thin `SKILL.md` router bundled in each use-case.

## Skills hosted here

- [edit-agent-dashboard](edit-agent-dashboard/llms.txt) — Edit the agent dashboard (`/use-cases/:id/operate`) of an installed use-case: rename phase/view, change layout, add or reuse a tab/view, add a new plugin route. Per-Instance + ephemeral.
- [clawexperts-code](clawexperts-code/llms.txt) — Knowledge core of ClawExperts Code, the agent that lets an End-User create, edit, test, package and share their own agent by chat: interview + charter, the default usage guide every built agent gets, plugin rules, test scenarios, Bundle format, platform architecture. Vietnamese. Written for OpenClaw 2026.9.9.

## How agents use this site

1. Bundled `SKILL.md` lists the URL of the relevant playbook for the current request.
2. Agent fetches the playbook via `WebFetch` / `curl` and follows the steps inside.
3. If the fetch fails, agent falls back to the bundled snapshot of the playbook (offline safety net).

## Conventions

- Every directory has its own `llms.txt` listing its files.
- Markdown for playbooks. YAML for schemas. `.tmpl` for code templates.
- No directory deeper than 2 levels — keeps URLs short.
- Paths are stable. To replace a playbook, write a new file + update the index; do not rename.
